narrative.overview: jamjam.dev reads like a developer's workspace after hours: dark surfaces, green accent glow, mono prompts that wink without cosplay. The system is brand-register work where personality is the product. Density is moderate: generous hero type, tight mono labels, bordered containers instead of floating card shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first tonal layering instead of shadows

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Green accent appears on ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The No Cream Rule
rules.body: Never introduce warm near-white body backgrounds.

rules.name: The Terminal Earned Rule
rules.body: Mono labels belong on section headers, status lines, and metadata. Do not put jamjam:~$ on every heading.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Hover is a tonal nudge, never a lifted shadow.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: No glassmorphism or frosted panels unless a Lab experiment calls for it.

dos: Do keep the page background at Void Black (#0a0a0a) and build hierarchy through borders and tonal shifts.
Do use Terminal Teal (#44aa99) for links and Studio Green (#629168) for focus, selection, and status.
Do write section labels in mono with // or shell-style prompts where they add personality.
Do use GSAP power3.out for hero reveals and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do show real project imagery and writing; design frames the work.
donts: Don't build generic SaaS landing pages: no cream backgrounds, hero metrics, identical feature card grids, or buzzword copy.
Don't ship template portfolio patterns: no Inter/default sans swaps, purple gradients, or endless same-sized icon + heading + blurb cards.
Don't slide into corporate brochure tone: no stock photography fillers or synergy language.
Don't use border-left or border-right accent stripes on cards or callouts.
Don't apply gradient text for emphasis.
Don't put a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section.
